about_the_game:
Eye of the Beholder Demo Features:

  • Full game eye throwing mechanics

  • Eploration of the first Dungeon of the game

  • Featuring 4 Spatial puzzles

  • 2 Surreal and terrifying enemies

  • A Unique Visual presentation

  • 3 Unique environmental interactions

  • Key voice acted lines for the tutorial

Eye of The Beholder Demo

In this demo, you will get introduced to the Arcane Eye, the tool that will get you through the trials in your mind. As well as 4 puzzles, 2 monsters, and a decorated environment and soundscape to immerse yourself in the world of Eye of the Beholder!

About Eye of the Beholder:

In Eye of the Beholder, you play as a mysterious witch named Delilah. Using the power that an eldritch god has granted you. You are tasked to escape the prison you find yourself in. Around every corner, some monsters can only be seen with the help of Balor and Morgan, a sentient eye with two personalities. Balor and Morgan may not see things the same way, but they both will help you escape with your life and help you achieve your goal

Gameplay:

Eye of the Beholder is a stealth-based horror game. You are wandering around a dungeon, casting spells and gaining vantage points by seeing through a cursed eye that you can throw. By using your tools and your wits, you can outmaneuver different monsters to escape with your life.

About Eye of the Beholder:

The debut of Final Croak LLC is here! A brand new team that has been put together has put together this project using Unreal Engine 5. A very dedicated art team has made dozens of hand drawn assets. (no AI) These assets include original monsters, character designs, and dungeon layouts. A lot of work went into the aesthetic of this game as well as the sound design. This team has spent a lot of time and effort to give you a truly horrifying experience.

content_descriptors.notes: The game explores concepts of insanity. The themes provided are not intended for all audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX-4000 series or newer, Intel® Arc™ A-Series Graphics Cards or newer, or NVIDIA RTX-1000 series or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX-4000 series or newer, Intel® Arc™ A-Series Graphics Cards or newer, or NVIDIA RTX-1000 series or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: Eye of the Beholder is a stealth-based horror game. Flee monsters and conquer your memories to gain power. See the unseen, turn your memory to ash, and escape with your sanity intact.
